{{Infobox/Armor piece |type = Helmet |rarity = Legendary |id = REAPER_MASK |slayer_level_requirement = Zombie Slayer 7 |dungeon_level_requirement = {{Skl|catacombs|24}} (when dungeonized) |gemstone_slots = *1 Ruby *1 Sapphire &50000, 20 Fine Sapphire& |health = +150 |defense = +100 |intelligence = +100 |vitality = +60 |mending = +60 |museum = yes |museum_xp = 8 |museum_category = combat |upgrades_from=Revived Heart |raw_materials = *660480 String *368640 Rotten Flesh *16384 Revenant Flesh *40960 Diamond *1 Beheaded Horror |mat_cost_bazaar = *128 Revenant Viscera *256 Enchanted Diamond *2304 Enchanted Rotten Flesh *32 Enchanted String *16384 Revenant Flesh |bazaar_not_including = {{Item|Beheaded Horror|amount=1|image=|noimgpad=y}} |enchantable=y |reforgeable=y}} The '''Reaper Mask''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Helmet]] unlocked from [[Slayer Quests]] that requires {{Coll|Zombie Slayer LVL 7}}. [[Zombie Armor]] triggers on all hits.
Store {{Cyan|2}} extra [[necromancer]] souls.
Summon {{Cyan|2}} extra necromancy souls. }} == Essence Crafting == {{Essence Crafting |200 |400 |600 |800 |1000 |convert = 500 |essence = Undead |type = weapon }} == Skins == {{Item Skins}} == Trivia == *The '''Reaper Mask''' uses the same texture as the {{MobSprite|Revenant Horror}}. *After the healing revamp, this mask is now obsolete with its double Vitality perk removed.
